name: 75 Broadway Brickell
statusRemark: 52 stories · private elevator foyers · across from Simpson Park
description: 75 Broadway is a 52-story residential tower by Ytech and Kohn Pedersen Fox on SW 15th Road, directly across from Simpson Park. Its 106 residences are deliberately limited to no more than three on a typical floor, with private elevator foyers, curved floor-to-ceiling glass, and views over the protected park canopy, Biscayne Bay and the Miami skyline. ACPV Architects designed the finished interiors, including a custom Arclinea kitchen with Gaggenau appliances.
editorialLine: Park, bay and skyline — at most three residences per floor.

amenitiesDescription:
More than 42,000 square feet is set aside for residents. Level 8 is dedicated to wellness and longevity, with hyperbaric oxygen therapy, cryotherapy, red light therapy, a cold plunge, gym, yoga studio, and a meditation and exercise garden overlooking Simpson Park.

The Owners Club on Level 51 provides a private lounge, bar and dining room. Level 52 is a rooftop garden and pool with a jacuzzi and bar above the bay. 75 Broadway is purely residential, with butler service developed in collaboration with the British Butler Institute.
